title: Layer options Torque
description: If you are using Torque as a layer resource, the following configurations are required in your MapConfig file. For more details about Torque layers in general, see the Torque API documentation.

sql.description:
The SQL request to the user database that will fetch the rendered data.

**Tip:** The SQL request should include the following Mapnik layer configurations:
  * geom_column
  * interactivity
  * attributes

step.description: The number of animation steps to render when requesting a torque.png tile.

geom_column.description:
The name of the column containing the geometry.

*You **must** specify this value as part of the Torque layer SQLconfiguration.

attributes.description:
The id and column values returned by the Torque attributes service. (This option is disabled if no configuration is defined).
*You **must** specify this value as part of the Torque layer SQL configuration.

id.description: The key value used to fetch columns.

columns.description: A string of values (columns) returned by the Torque attribute service.
